addInstances.description: Start new instances of a service implementation (sefa-instances-manager). New instances share the load equally as long as no per-instance weights are set.

removeInstance.description: Stop one instance (sefa-instances-manager). Take address and port from its instance id <implementation>@<address>:<port>.

port.description: Port inside the Docker network, e.g. 36057

changeLBWeights.description: Set load balancer weights of a service's instances (sefa-config-manager, commits to the config repo). Weights should sum to 1; an instance without a weight gets no traffic once any weight is set.

instancesToRemoveWeightOf.description: Instance ids whose weight entry should be deleted

changeProperty.description: Change properties in the config repo (sefa-config-manager), e.g. circuit breaker settings in ordering-service.properties.

propertiesToChange.description: List of {serviceName, propertyName, value}. serviceName null means application.properties; value null removes the property.
